description: Use this when you need the dates of the Dutch public holidays in a given year. Example prompt: "When is Ascension Day in the Netherlands in 2027?" Exact Dutch public holidays for a year, including movable feasts (Easter, Ascension, Whitsun) and King's Day rules. Use this instead of computing Dutch holidays yourself. Costs 1 credit. The answer is deterministic.
